checks.evidence: Sifted: "Barcelona, Spain-based Stark Future [...] raised €150m in funding." | EU-Startups: "raised more than €150 million at a €1.2 billion pre-money valuation" | TechCrunch Mobility: "raised [at least €150 million] in equity, Reuters reported."

summary: The one re-check passes: €150m raised (Sifted), in equity (TechCrunch Mobility, citing Reuters), €1.2bn pre-money valuation and Barcelona HQ (EU-Startups; Sifted also gives Barcelona, Spain), and no source states a stage. Note that only Sifted gives a flat €150m; EU-Startups says "more than €150 million" and TechCrunch Mobility "at least €150 million", so the figure is a floor in two of the three sources.
